sentinel-coordinator.description: Coordinates Sentinel commissioning, delegates bounded work, and owns final verification and reporting.

sentinel-implementer.description: Implements one bounded Sentinel task without secrets, remediation, or recursive delegation.

sentinel-reviewer.description: Performs a strict read-only Sentinel architecture, security, and correctness review.

sentinel-validator.description: Runs read-only static and safe disposable validation and reports evidence without treating skips as passes.
